name: Katlego Sekonya
missingPieces: Capstone D2 omitted Artefact 04 and gave incorrect recovered plaintext for Artefacts 01, 02, and 05.
feedback: Your platform write-ups show good understanding of the alg:none JWT root cause, the MD5 then SHA-256 rotation order, and the difference between encoding and encryption. Task 3 loses marks because Artefact A needed a clear unrecoverable conclusion, and the Base64 plaintext for Artefact B was not copied accurately. The major weakness is the capstone appendix: D2 gives the wrong plaintext for the AES artefact, treats the wrong Vigenere text as a capstone classical cipher answer, omits Artefact 04, and gives the wrong layered memo plaintext. D3 is more useful because the controls are practical and mostly cost-aware, but it is built on several incorrect D2 artefact interpretations. Next time, verify each recovered plaintext against the provided artefact before using it as evidence in the board report.
